title: Identify the quadrant
text: Tangent is negative in the second and fourth quadrants. For the tangent function, we only need to find one primary angle because its unique period will naturally cover the opposite quadrant. Let's look at the second quadrant.

title: Find the specific angles
text: The reference angle where the absolute value of tangent equals $$1$$ is $$\frac{\pi}{4}.$$ In the second quadrant, this angle is $$\pi-\frac{\pi}{4}=\frac{3\pi}{4}.$$

title: Add periodicity
text: Unlike sine and cosine, the standard tangent function has a period of $$\pi.$$ To find all possible solutions, add integer multiples of this smaller period ( $$n\pi$$ ).
